## Demo: Combining functions

Notebook, section *Kombination von Funktionen*

- A Taylor polynomial combines basis functions $(x - x_0)^k$ with coefficients
- In Julia: a vector of coefficients times a vector of functions
- Same pattern as the finite element approximation $u_h$ later

## Demo: Hat functions

Notebook, section *Stückweise lineare Funktionen - Hutfunktionen*

- `MMJMesh` creates the piecewise linear basis functions for given nodes
- Combining them with the degrees of freedom $\hat{u}_i$ gives a piecewise linear function

## Demo: Linear span

Notebook, section *Lineare Hülle*

- Random coefficients give random elements of $\mathrm{Lin}(\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_N)$
- All of them are piecewise linear: this is the set in which we look for $u_h$
